description: Put a retired source back in force with the version it had, as Restore on the Sources tab does: what it states counts as intended again and the judge reviews against it. A source from the agent's code comes back by running the coding agent setup with it; one from the connection settings is changed there.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

source.description: The retired source's id, as list_sources shows it.
source.title: Source

name: restore_source
